name: 黑底虚焦双层人物小窗

readiness.scope: 已有机制演示通过；精细版仅所列原生窗口经过实际编码审核，其他真实编排仍待完成。

source.author: 剪辑师小船
source.title: 为什么低价剪辑做不出网感？看完这组前后对比你就全明白了

semantic_use: 腾出空间给概念，同时继续保留人物。
observed_motion: 全幅人物虚化后，先出现上方人物窗，再出现下方人物窗，各自有说明字幕。

basic_implementation.scope: 只复刻精剪栏的内部机制，不复制价格和优劣宣传。
basic_implementation.parameter_scope: Listed parameters are runtime spec fields. Design variables such as band ratios, path coordinates and entry timing remain authored engine defaults and require a project-specific code adaptation; not an arbitrary automatic inverse-effects system.
basic_implementation.preview_limit: Early four-second mechanism and alternate-content samples are simplified; they do not establish native fidelity or arbitrary filmed-foreground reuse.

presenter_rules.opening: 本人画面承担开头与立场
presenter_rules.returns: 按重要观点、情绪转折和收尾回到人物，不机械每N秒，不只出现一次。
presenter_rules.fit: 匹配本人的取景、脸部占窗和真实上半身，不能扩展不存在的人体像素。
presenter_rules.alpha: 需前景人物效果时用与实际母片时间一致的动态alpha，不能用静态抠像替代移动人物。

adaptation.new_clip_reference: New reference/reference-native specs bind the accepted user master and its native window/SHA/PTS. Learned tutorial provenance stays in this recipe. Reusing an existing recipe does not require redownloading/restudying its tutorial.
adaptation.trigger: 根据当前口播真实词轴触发，保持选定配色/文字体系/层次/动作顺序。
adaptation.missing_measurement: 原字体、原工程和未覆盖分支如实标记；授权替代字体重排后检查当前文案。

validation.basic_mechanism_preview: Original 30 source entries and28 modules each have actual primary/replacement-content preview records in assets/social-grammars/validation.json.

residuals: Different genuine stock presenter, face/gestures/room; no original actor replay. Silent technical animation reconstruction, no voice/lip-sync claim.
Original font/project unknown. Private original fixed glyph art cannot be advertised as arbitrary editable original font.
Source native H264 compression and new H264 codec colors/antialiasing differ; no100% pixel claim.
Reference effective right panel ROI434×777 is normalized to1080×1920; original frame still used for timing/measurement, tutorial UI and promotional prices are omitted.
Blur sigma≈32native ROIpx and rear dim alpha≈.38 are estimates, background belongs to different real stock shot.
Moving face crops calibrated to PIP aspect; original clothing/lamp/face and specific speech cannot match.
Label glyphs retain only private fixed phrases; replacement wording requires separately reviewed editable font.
原效果区域434×777被映射为1080×1920，有0.7%长宽非均匀映射；原宣传双栏与价格/时间轴不复刻。

固定标签白色笔画与源字体形状接近，阈值和黑边导致约1–2原ROI像素边缘差异；新文案不能继续复用原字形。

font.source_family: unknown from compressed reference; fixed isolated glyph study only
font.editable_fallback: NotoSansSC/available system font, approximate shape must be separately reviewed

subject_face_to_window_ratio.measurement_limit: manual native hair-to-chin within upper PIP; actor-specific residual

layout.upper_body_visible: PIP crops show head and upper chest; camera source has no visible hands

grammar.event_policy: real measured source events; cut/pulse/path ordering preserved, new narration must align to accepted word clock

replacement_limits.fixed_source_glyphs: not editable; new phrase requires approximate font or separately identified licensed original font
replacement_limits.timing: reuse native enter/hold/exit proportions, map to new word/semantic clock with no claim of exact same phrase animation
replacement_limits.subject: different footage must be reframed and reviewed rather than copied old face coordinates
